_doc: Prediction ledger for newsletter call-grading. synthesize_newsletter.py feeds status='open' entries to Claude to grade in each issue; the editor then runs manage_predictions.py to mark them graded and add this issue's new calls. Versioned in git as the credibility record. Grades: hit | miss | partial.

predictions.claim: The Health Care / biotech wave (VKTX, RCUS, COGT, RYTM, APGE and peers) holds its rank gains into a second week, confirming a real rotation rather than a one-week spark.
Semiconductors stay in the lower half of the sector board and do not reclaim a top-20 peer-group rank, as the chip trade keeps consolidating.
The regime stays healthy: VIX remains below 20 and the share of stocks above their 200-day holds above 60%.
